title: Mourncrest 01: The Restless Dead [64x64]

sheetLayout.note: Row order is down/left/right/up — RPG Maker character-sheet order. frames.json gives every frame's x/y/w/h. ⚠️ boneHound is the one exception to the row semantics: it is drawn in side view in all four rows. See boneHoundViewNote.

characterRoles.skeleton: The rank and file of the barrow. A spear standing clear above the skull.
characterRoles.wraith: A hooded revenant in a long grave-cloth coat. Skeletal claws at the cuffs and a heavy boot stride.
characterRoles.ghoul: Bent double. Head thrust forward past its own shoulders.
characterRoles.wight: The barrow-king. The broadest, hardest silhouette in the pack.
characterRoles.gravebound: Half-swallowed by the barrow. A wide mound instead of legs.
characterRoles.boneHound: The barrow's dog. The only four-legged thing in the pack. DRAWN IN SIDE VIEW IN ALL FOUR DIRECTIONS - see boneHoundViewNote.

generator: PixelLab (pixflux 128px -> /rotate -> /animate-with-skeleton), palette-locked by Kernel/sprites/pixelise.js. Every offered grid is native at that size.
boneHoundViewNote: boneHound is drawn in SIDE VIEW in all four directions. Its east and west frames are true opposed profiles; its south and north frames are side views too, not a front and a back view. This is deliberate and it is a limitation, not an oversight: a skeletal quadruped seen head-on is a view our generator cannot hold while also holding the bare-bone anatomy - three attempts across two years of tooling are on record, and each one returned either a correct front view of a LIVE dog or a correct skeleton back in profile. Every other character in this pack has true front, back and opposed side views. If you need a strict four-direction hound, use this one as a side-facing creature, or use its east/west frames for all movement.
